design.decision: Bid nil only with a partner who can safely make a contract, since both must succeed.
design.opponent: Revealed at scoring; opponents can deny it by breaking the nil or setting the partner.
design.rationale: Unlike nil points (seed-nil-points, -3.0), these are contract points and need the contract too, so the payoff rewards the safe nil-plus-made plan and is lost on a set.
design.draftText: +80 contract points if your team makes a nil

critic.concerns: The Exact tag has no basis, because a made nil doesn't depend on exact tricks.
